workouts.title: Conditioning
workouts.description:
Wingate(ish): C2 Bike erg
Score: 30 seconds- ave wattage

1. Warm-up: 60 rpm for 4 minutes @damper 1
2. @ 4 min mark Warm-up sprint: 3 seconds @ damper 10 (RPM's as high as possible)
3. Continue cycling to the 5 min mark 60 rpm's @ damper 1

4. Rest 2 mins

5. Test:
Cycle for 10 seconds 60rpms @ damper 1
then,
30 seconds as fast as possible @damper X (Based on Bodyweight)

6. Cool down: 2-3 mins 60rpms @damper 1

Score is average wattage
